name: CDC/ATSDR Social Vulnerability Index (SVI) 2022
publisher: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention / Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry (CDC/ATSDR)
source_release_id: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 (US and state-ranked counties and census tracts, ACS 2018-2022)

geography_rules.county: Five-digit FIPS joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 county-equivalent GEOID. Connecticut appears as planning regions (09110-09190). Unmatched rows are staged as source_only and not published.
geography_rules.tract: Eleven-digit FIPS joined exactly to TIGER/Line 2024 census tract GEOID. Connecticut appears as planning-region tracts. Unmatched rows are staged as source_only and not published.

boundary.vintage: TIGER/Line 2024 counties and census tracts (Connecticut planning regions)

population_by_level.tract: Rank among all U.S. census tracts

population_note: Each is based on ACS 2018–2022 estimates for all residents.
limitations: These are CDC/ATSDR's percentile ranks among all U.S. counties, or among all U.S. tracts. They are not rates, and they do not measure risk for any one person.
The ranks compare areas within one SVI release. Do not compare them with ranks from other SVI years, or with state-ranked SVI files.
CHIP publishes CDC's ranks as released. It does not re-rank, average, or combine themes.
The ranks are built on ACS 2018–2022 estimates, which have margins of error. CDC publishes no uncertainty for the ranks.
A county rank and a tract rank come from separate rankings, so they are not comparable.
A within-state rank compares an area only with others in the same state. Colors on a national map mean different things in different states.
DC has one county, so its within-DC county rank is 0.

measures.label: Overall social vulnerability (percentile rank)
measures.population: All U.S. counties or all U.S. census tracts (ACS 2018–2022 estimates for all residents)

population_by_level.tract: Rank among all U.S. census tracts

measures.denominator: US-wide percentile rank (0–1); higher values indicate greater vulnerability.
measures.official_definition: CDC/ATSDR SVI 2022 overall summary ranking across all four themes (RPL_THEMES), built on ACS 2018–2022 5-year estimates.
measures.interpretation: Percentile rank (0–1) among all U.S. counties or all U.S. census tracts; higher values indicate greater social vulnerability. Not a rate and not a measure of risk for any one person.
